title: Independent investigation of taurine–donor interaction energies
difficulty_reasons: The agent must generate and prioritize a substantial set of binding poses and conformers for three complexes.
The agent must formulate and discriminate plausible energetic explanations while validating minima and BSSE-corrected energies.

paper.title: Separation of taurine and Na2SO4 via the in situ formation of deep eutectic solvents: experiments and computational simulation

data.description: Complete public chemical identity specification for Tau, Im, Gly (glycerol), MEA, charge, multiplicity, and 1:2 complex stoichiometry.

required_deliverables.description: Validated energies, candidate records, protocol, proposed explanations and discriminating evidence, ordering, and limitations.
